newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three mln investors apply for Telekom - Bild.
newsitem.headline: Three mln investors apply for Telekom - Bild.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Telekom expects a total of around three million investors to have applied for shares in its forthcoming flotation, its chairman Ron Sommer said in an interview with the Bild newspaper.
"We are optimistic that we will have got around three million people," Sommer said in the Saturday edition of the paper. Friday was the deadline for applications from private investors.
Full pricing and allocation details for the 13-17 billion mark issue will be announced immediately before trading starts on November 18 in Germany and New York.
